name: 90/90 Hip Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your front knee bent about 90 degrees and your shin angled across your body. Bend the opposite knee behind you so both legs form a comfortable 90/90 position.
Sit tall and keep both sitting bones as close to the floor as your mobility allows. Place your hands beside your hips for support.
Keeping your chest long and your back controlled, slowly hinge forward over the front leg until you feel a mild stretch around the hip and glute.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily. Do not force the knee or allow sharp pain.
Return to an upright position, change the leg arrangement, and repeat on the other side for 2-3 rounds.
